progress.discovering: Listening for Sony projector announcements for up to {seconds} seconds

user.title: Select a Sony projector
user.description: Projectors broadcasting Sony SDAP announcements appear automatically.

select.title: Select a Sony projector
select.description: Select a discovered projector or enter its address manually.

manual.title: Enter projector address
manual.description: ADCP must be enabled in the projector's network settings.

auth.title: Projector authentication
auth.description: The projector at {host} requires its web administrator password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the projector

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The address belongs to a different projector

custom_sensors.title: Custom sensors
custom_sensors.description: Named, read-only ADCP values share the projector's refresh interval and device. Adding, editing or removing a sensor reloads the integration without removing power controls.

sensor.title: Custom ADCP sensor
sensor.description: Enter a command name without arguments or ?. Read-only queries run at the configured interval while fully on. Saving reloads the integration; model support is checked at the next refresh. [Custom sensor documentation]({documentation_url})

data_description.command: Lowercase command name, for example aspect. The integration appends ?; commands cannot set values.
data_description.json_field: Leave empty for the whole response. For JSON, use dot-separated keys and zero-based array indexes, for example 0.main.
data_description.unit: Optional display unit such as %. No device class or statistics type is inferred.

confirm_remove.title: Remove custom sensor?
confirm_remove.description: Remove {name}? Only this custom sensor is removed. Projector power and other controls are kept.

refresh.title: Projector status refresh
refresh.description: Choose how often to refresh input, signal, custom sensors, and optional picture settings while fully on. Normal refresh pauses during fast power monitoring.

data_description.operational_refresh_interval: Changes apply immediately. Disabled stops periodic input, signal, picture-setting and custom-sensor checks, but not SDAP or power monitoring.
data_description.refresh_picture_settings: Refresh supported, enabled picture controls at the same interval: picture mode, sharpness, brightness, contrast, light output, Reality Creation, and video mute. Off keeps input, signal and custom-sensor refresh.

error.invalid_name: Enter a name between 1 and 100 characters
error.invalid_command: Use a lowercase command name only: letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (maximum 64 characters). Do not include spaces, arguments or ?.
error.invalid_json_field: Use dot-separated keys or array indexes (maximum 128 characters), or leave empty
error.invalid_unit: Units require a numeric sensor and must be 30 characters or fewer

abort.too_many_sensors: A projector can have at most 32 custom sensors. Remove one before adding another.
abort.sensor_not_found: This sensor no longer exists. Open Configure again.

command_name_invalid.message: Enter one lowercase ADCP command name without arguments or options.

command_operation_invalid.message: This operation is not supported for the command. Use explicit power on/off instead of the power-toggle key.

command_value_invalid.message: The value is invalid, outside the reported range, or not a supported choice. Use the exact case reported by Sony; quote on/off strings in YAML.

command_value_unexpected.message: Omit the value field for Reset and Execute operations.

command_metadata_required.message: The projector did not provide command metadata. No write was sent. Check model support and try while fully on.

command_type_unsupported.message: Only ordinary menu settings, execution commands, remote keys and explicit power are supported. Network settings and advanced calibration are excluded.

command_device_invalid.message: Select an existing Sony ADCP projector device.

command_not_ready.message: The projector integration is not loaded, is unloading, or its power state changed before sending. Try again after it is ready.

command_during_transition.message: Wait for the power transition to finish before sending other commands.

command_rejected.message: The projector rejected the command: {response}. No automatic retry was made.

command_authentication.message: Projector authentication failed. Complete reauthentication in the integration.

command_outcome_unknown.message: No valid acknowledgement was received before the connection or deadline ended. The command may have executed and was not automatically resent. Check projector state before repeating it.

command_connection.message: Unable to communicate with the projector. Check its address, network-management setting and connection.

query_type_invalid.message: Choose Current value, Allowed values / range, or Command information. Queries cannot include a value or write operation.

query_stale.message: The projector power state changed during this query. Try again after it is ready.

query_timeout.message: The read-only query exceeded its 30-second deadline, including connection and queue waits. Try again when the projector is ready.

query_rejected.message: The projector rejected the query: {response}. Check command support and try while fully on.
